entries.08bda991c16abda1: This is the business the company operates at its core. It runs free kimono dressing classes for new customers, and plans classes and various events for graduates, who are existing customers, providing sales opportunities to contracted companies that have entered sales outsourcing agreements. The company brokers sales from a neutral standpoint and also carries out management of the group as a whole.
entries.4aa312e45fd26c0c: A company centered on brokering sales of Japanese clothing products, providing contracted companies with opportunities to sell kimono to participants and graduates gathered through free kimono dressing classes.
entries.762c1edf8da40d6d: Students and graduates of dressing classes
entries.77f55f47ba4d3f88: Consolidated subsidiary NIHONWASOU TRADING CO.,LTD operates a kimono sewing business in the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, and NIHONWASOU(VIETNAM)CO.,LTD provides production management consulting for kimono sewing, and planning, design and production management consulting for accessories and other goods.
entries.7b0bdbac886b1074: Consolidated subsidiary Nihon Wasou Okinawa Co., Ltd. operates the Nihon Wasou Business in Okinawa Prefecture and also runs a wholesale business in kimono and kimono accessories for the company's contracted companies.
entries.8b405676a69041dc: A single-segment business centered on brokering the sale of kimono and kimono accessories. It provides contracted companies with opportunities to sell kimono, obi and other items to students and graduates of its free kimono dressing classes, and also takes on, from each contracted company, end-to-end process management covering the processing of purchased items through to delivery. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥4,485 million.
entries.8f890571980c31b2: Nihon Wasou Business in Okinawa (Nihon Wasou Okinawa)
entries.a334e26d9dbe0c87: Students of free kimono dressing classes
entries.a4ac607b09d62088: To improve the convenience of payment settlement for students and graduates, consolidated subsidiary Nichikure Co., Ltd. operates an installment sales agency business and a prepaid specified transactions business (friends' association business).
entries.a6e35d6deb067d7d: Consolidated subsidiary Meinsutēji Co., Ltd. operates a kimono-specialized model agency business. Ownership is 90% by the company and 10% by Dentsu Group Inc.
entries.a77633d8e8ff2a43: Students of dressing classes in Okinawa Prefecture
entries.b19d49e8e18010ca: Consolidated subsidiary Nihon Wasou Direct Co., Ltd. operates a mail-order business focused on kimono accessories, aimed at students, graduates and general consumers.
entries.b575ebccaae7206e: Contracted companies, such as kimono and obi manufacturers, general wholesalers of Japanese-style goods, and producer cooperatives
entries.b894d0feb78ec598: Kimono sewing and production management in Vietnam (NIHONWASOU TRADING and others)
entries.c38fa05c7f762f98: Consolidated subsidiary Hakata Takumi Kogei Co., Ltd. manufactures Hakata-ori and, as a contracted company of the Nihon Wasou Business, sells products to students and graduates. It also operates the men's kimono specialty store 'SAMURAI'.
